title: Farwa Tere Laal Nu, Aj Mehndi Lawan Aae
body:
Farwa Tere Laal Nu, Aj Mehndi Lawan Aae yaan
Haey Phupiyan, Qasim Day, Aj Shagan Manawan’ Aae yaan
<<DIVIDER>>
1- Tukreyan Walay Laaray Nu, Dus Ferwa Kinj Pernae aye
Keray Keray Tukray Nu, Shagna Di Mehndi Lae Aye
Sehray Day, Phul’an Nu, Eydi Laash Tay Paa wun’ Aae yaan
<<DIVIDER>>
2- Pucheya Zainab Nay Ki Daywa, Qasim Laag Mei Tere
Wasda Vayra Ujar Gaya, Na Puttar Bachey Nay Mere
Chadran Nu, Tere Sir Di, Asi Vayl Karawan’ Aae yaan
<<DIVIDER>>
3- Janj Charan’ Ton Pehlan Mar Gaey, Qasim Jaan Jee Saaray
Rait Garam Tay Sogaye nay, mawan day raj dularay
Asi Qasim, Tere Jaan Jee, Mitiyan Chon Chaawan’ Aae yaan
<<DIVIDER>>
4- Saj Raee Mehndi Hathan Tay, Kiwain Qubra Rasiyan Paaway
Shaam Day Okhay Safaran Vich, Teri Bayva Na Mar Jaway
Uth Qasim, Tainu Phupian, Dukh Dard Sunawan’ Aae yaan
<<DIVIDER>>
5- Rakh Kay Ghatri Maqtal Vich, Shabeer Nay Hath Jadon Kholay
Vaikheya Kubra Day Babay, Thaan Thaan Ton Qasim Bolay
Aj Hooran, Arshaan Ton, Imdaad Karawan’ Aae yaan
<<DIVIDER>>
6- Nai Dastoor Samar Jug Da, Einj Ras’am Veya Di Hovay
Laray Di Sehra Bandi, Tay Dulhan Aa Kay Rovay
Rab Janay, Kerbal Vich, Kiwain Rasam Nibhawan’ Aae yaan
